W.note: 5-7-5 (Pearl cloud af-ter dusk=5; the pink lets go of its edge=7; one watch-er then grey=5); 'pearl cloud' only hints at nacreous clouds but the fading pink and single watcher give a quiet turn.

X.note: 5-7-5 (Moth-er-of-pearl veils=5; na-cre-ous light at dusk slow=7; fire on fro-zen air=5 if fire is one syllable); names nacreous clouds accurately and 'fire on frozen air' is striking, but the middle line is stiff and there is no turn.

Y.note: 5-7-5 (Moth-er-of-pearl cloud=5; pink green gold then on-ly grey=7; my breath still ris-ing=5); the colour sequence into grey and the human breath at the end give a true cut and feeling.

Z.note: Na-cre-ous glow=4 (short of 5), mother-of-pearl in the dusk=7, the sky holds its breath=5, so the form breaks; 'sky holds its breath' is stock and the imagery is thin.
